source: Captured 2026-10-14 from a real LiveKit Agents session on LiveKit Cloud (agent run locally in dev mode) through the agent's own observability upload (LIVEKIT_OBSERVABILITY_URL, decision 0014): OTLP spans, chat_history.json and the stereo recording.ogg. The first agent process crashed (exit -11) 4 s after joining; LiveKit reassigned the job and the second process ran the call, so the recording and spans start when that session started. STT Deepgram, LLM OpenAI, TTS OpenAI. The caller is a scripted participant speaking synthetic audio.
